details: 1428 integer raw byte comparisons (714 linear + 714 graph): 17 integer filters x 6 formats (gray, yuv420p, yuv422p, yuv444p, yuva420p, gbrp) x 7 sizes (1x1, 2x2, 5x3, 7x5, 8x6, 17x9, 40x7) x 3 frames (noise, ramp/edges, constant); plus 504 native default-threads vs -filter_complex_threads 1 agreements for the 12 filters without column mode (all platforms)
840 float raw byte comparisons (420 linear + 420 graph): 10 float rdiv/bias filters x 6 formats x 7 sizes; plus 252 thread agreements for the 6 filters without column mode (linux-x64 only)

1728 integer whole-output CLI comparisons: 6 formats x {7x5,17x9} x 4 chains x {rawvideo,framecrc} x 3 timing scopes (none, -ss 0.04 input + -t 0.05, -ss 0.04 -frames:v 1) x 6 executions (-vf linear, -filter_complex graph, two-input stream, timed activation and producer = actor, timed pull = timed)
288 float whole-output CLI comparisons: 6 formats x 7x5 x 2 chains x 2 muxers x 2 scopes x 6 executions (linux-x64 only)

16 native refusal-status observations (10 native refusals: exit 234 EINVAL, 222 ERANGE or 8 option not found from os.constants.errno; 6 natively accepted forms refused here) with 80 EdgeFFmpeg path refusals
24 null-filter cases: 17 native SIGSEGV observations refused here on 5 paths (85 refusals) and 7 byte matches where the plane is absent
89 per-source negotiation checks (13 sources byte-exact on every path, 4 packed-alpha sources refused naming gbrap)

unsupported: all runtime commands (option commands return ENOSYS, enable returns AVERROR_PATCHWELCOME); native accepts them and reruns param_init
matrix tokens that are not plain decimal int32 (native sscanf keeps a leading integer or leaves a stale element), more than 49 tokens (native ignores the rest)
expression or non-decimal rdiv/bias values (constant decimal literals only)
processed identity square planes with rdiv != 1 or bias != 0, which crash natively (null filter pointer, SIGSEGV)

9-16 bit formats (filter16_*) and native formats without frame storage here (yuva444p, yuva422p, yuv440p, yuvj440p, yuvj411p, yuv411p, yuv410p, gbrap, gray9-16); negotiated picks such as gbrap from packed RGB with alpha are refused by name

native column-mode outputs whose 16-column groups overrun the frame linesize (slice threading, -cpuflags 0): EdgeFFmpeg returns the defined mirrored column result, equal to single-threaded native at the default alignment
no planes option exists natively; per-plane selection is by identity matrices
EdgeFFmpeg CLI exit status for filter refusals is 1, not native errno status (shared front-end mapping)

notes: Setup: the sandbox Node was v22.23.5 and bootstrap requires Node 24; /opt/node24 (v24.22.3) was used for every command. bootstrap --only npm,submodule,reference --allow-unpinned-reference took 232.1s (npm 9.7s, submodule 12.6s, reference build 209.8s). Baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries 60s clean; registry unit test 8/8 before changes.
The sandbox reference (ac302e4d) differs from the linux-x64 pin; the differential tests check only commit 946fcce0 and --disable-x86asm from build-metadata.json.

Native defect found: an identity square matrix with rdiv != 1 or bias != 0 on a processed plane makes native call a null filter pointer (SIGSEGV), e.g. convolution=0bias=5. Refused here in geometry and frame.

Native defect found: filter_column writes 16-column groups from every slice start past the row end; when a group passes the linesize (slice threads, -cpuflags 0) native output depends on write order (observed: gray 64x9 and 128x9 default threads vs -filter_threads 1; 8x6, 17x9, 32x9, 33x9 under -cpuflags 0). EdgeFFmpeg returns the defined result; column filters are compared with single-threaded native, and the [THREADS] agreement is asserted for square and row filters only. The negotiation filter avoids column mode because the helper runs native with -cpuflags 0.
The scope mentions a planes option, but vf_convolution.c declares none (native: Option not found, exit 8). It is refused; per-plane selection uses identity matrices.
Float gate: no macOS difference was measured (precaution). Mutating the emulation to a fused multiply-add or to a double intermediate fails the float matrix test on this Linux build.
Differential file runtime: about 22s with --maxWorkers=1 on 4 vCPUs.
